scraped_metrics.runtime_health_source_boundary: queue_depth, database_connections, provider_failure, authority_mismatch and projection_drift are sampled by the real deep-health path; provider failure is explicitly simulated and all observations remain non-authoritative

semantic_signal_closure.authority_unknown_policy: missing task/tenant/project-scope/capability/step/epoch is NOT_OBSERVED and omits authority.mismatch observation
semantic_signal_closure.projection_unknown_policy: missing project/source/offset/read error is NOT_OBSERVED or ERROR and omits projection.drift observation
semantic_signal_closure.projection_drift_basis: active C9 offset source_digest compared with freshly derived closure_digest; release mismatch alone is not C9 drift

live_runtime_health_chain.recovery: Redis LLEN celery=0 plus simulated provider healthy; controller-derived local/runtime receipt validated queue alert recovered

runtime_source_boundary_not_claimed: No external provider call or production receipt was created
